title: Pin optional Go tooling and fail-closed candidate checks

acceptance_criteria.description: Pinned optional tooling and fail-closed checks work without affecting Haskell targets.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Boundary unit tests, native Go checks, Nix verification or explicit unavailable result, migration validation and diff scope.

evidence.command: 8 tooling boundary tests; native Go tooling and synthetic executable checks; isolated Nix Go version/format verification; migration validator and scope checks

handoff: Optional tooling is ready for independent review; native Haskell/full parity checks are unrun and license/native-code caveats are recorded. No service compatibility is claimed.
